整数线性程序的精确数据驱动逆优化的显式迭代复杂度Explicit Iteration Complexity of Exact Data-Driven Inverse Optimization for Integer Linear Programs

Akira Kitaoka NEC Corporation, 1753 Shimonumabe, Nakahara-ku, Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan akira-kitaoka@nec.com
摘要。Abstract.

数据驱动的逆优化问题 (DDIOP) 是估计解释观察到的最优解数据的目标函数参数（权重）的问题，它出现在许多应用中，包括整数线性规划 (ILP)。众所周知，通过将基于梯度的优化方法应用于次优损失，可以在有限多次预言迭代内精确求解 ILP 的逆优化，并且所需的迭代次数有界为A data-driven inverse optimization problem (DDIOP) is the problem of estimating the objective-function parameters (weights) that explain observed optimal-solution data, and it arises in many applications, including integer linear programming (ILP). It is known that, by applying gradient-based optimization methods to the suboptimality loss, the inverse optimization of ILPs can be solved exactly within finitely many oracle iterations, and that the required number of iterations is bounded asT=O​(1/γ​(ℓsub)2)T=O(1/\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})^{2})根据问题相关的几何常数in terms of a problem-dependent geometric constantγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})。但没有办法限制. However, no means of boundingγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})从下面可以看出，作为问题大小的函数已经可用，因此迭代次数不能作为问题大小的显式函数给出。因此，当前向问题是整数线性规划（ILP）时，我们给出足以将投影次梯度下降应用于次优性损失的迭代次数，以实现与观测数据的精确一致性，作为样本数量、特征维度、特征范围和约束系数矩阵结构的完全显式函数，直到基本常数中的多项式因子（权重集的直径、步长参数和次优性的 Lipschitz 常数）损失）。from below as a function of the problem size has been available, and hence the number of iterations could not be given as an explicit function of the problem size. We therefore give, when the forward problem is an integer linear program (ILP), the number of iterations sufficient for projected subgradient descent applied to the suboptimality loss to achieve exact consistency with the observed data, as a fully explicit function of the number of samples, the dimension of the features, the ranges of the features, and the structure of the constraint coefficient matrix, up to polynomial factors in the basic constants (the diameter of the weight set, the step-size parameter, and the Lipschitz constant of the suboptimality loss).

1. 简介Introduction

逆优化是根据观察到的最优解估计目标函数或其参数的问题Inverse optimization is the problem of estimating an objective function or its parameters from observed optimal solutions(Ahuja and Orlin, 2001; Heuberger, 2004; Chan et al., 2019, 2023)，具有广泛的应用，包括运输, with a wide range of applications including transportation(Bertsimas et al., 2015)、电力系统, power systems(Birge et al., 2017), 医疗保健, healthcare(Chan et al., 2022)、广告调度, advertisement scheduling(Suzuki et al., 2019)，以及逆强化学习, and inverse reinforcement learning(Ng et al., 2000).

在本文中，我们将前向问题的目标函数给出为已知特征的线性组合的情况：对于每个状态In this paper, we treat the case where the objective function of the forward problem is given as a linear combination of known features: for each states∈𝒮s\in\mathcal{S}，给定一个可行区域, given a feasible regionX​(s)⊂𝒳X(s)\subset\mathcal{X}, 特征图, a feature mapf=(f1,…,fd):𝒳×𝒮→ℝdf=(f_{1},\ldots,f_{d})\colon\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{S}\to\mathbb{R}^{d}，和权重, and weightsθ∈Θ⊂ℝd\theta\in\Theta\subset\mathbb{R}^{d}，前向问题为, the forward problem isx∗​(θ,s)∈arg​maxx∈X​(s)⁡θ⊤​f​(x,s)x^{*}(\theta,s)\in\operatorname*{arg\,max}_{x\in X(s)}\theta^{\top}f(x,s)。 给定观测数据. Given observed data𝒟={(s(n),x(n))}n=1N\mathcal{D}=\{(s^{(n)},x^{(n)})\}_{n=1}^{N}, x(n)=x∗​(θ∗,s(n))x^{(n)}=x^{*}(\theta^{*},s^{(n)})，由未知的真实权重生成, generated by unknown true weightsθ∗\theta^{*}，数据驱动的逆优化问题（DDIOP）要求权重, the data-driven inverse optimization problem (DDIOP) asks for weightsθ\theta将每个观察到的解决方案解释为最佳解决方案（参见that explain every observed solution as an optimal solution (see˜3以获得精确的配方）。 特别是，设置for the precise formulation). In particular, settingf​(x,s)=xf(x,s)=x，该框架包括混合整数线性程序（MILP）。, this framework includes mixed integer linear programs (MILPs).

为了衡量与观察数据的一致性，我们比较观察到的特征To measure consistency with the observed data, we compare the observed featuresa(n):=f​(x(n),s(n))a^{(n)}:=f(x^{(n)},s^{(n)})与预测的特征with the predicted featuresa∗​(θ,s(n)):=f​(x∗​(θ,s(n)),s(n))a^{*}(\theta,s^{(n)}):=f(x^{*}(\theta,s^{(n)}),s^{(n)})。 代表性损失，特征的预测损失（PLF）. A representative loss, the prediction loss of features (PLF)ℓplf​(θ):=1N​∑n=1N∥a∗​(θ,s(n))−a(n)∥22\ell_{\mathrm{plf}}(\theta):=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\lVert a^{*}(\theta,s^{(n)})-a^{(n)}\rVert_{2}^{2} (Aswani et al., 2018; Chan et al., 2019; Babier et al., 2021; Chan et al., 2023; Ferber et al., 2023; Liang and Dvorkin, 2023), 在 MILP 的逆优化中通常是不连续的，因为, is in general discontinuous in inverse optimization for MILPs becausea∗​(θ,s(n))a^{*}(\theta,s^{(n)})可以不连续地变化can vary discontinuously with respect toθ\theta，这使得直接基于梯度的最小化变得困难, which makes direct gradient-based minimization difficult(cf. Beck, 2017; Hazan, 2019; Garrigos and Gower, 2023)。 相反，次优损失. In contrast, the suboptimality lossℓsub​(θ):=1N​∑n=1N(θ⊤​a∗​(θ,s(n))−θ⊤​a(n))\ell_{\mathrm{sub}}(\theta):=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}(\theta^{\top}a^{*}(\theta,s^{(n)})-\theta^{\top}a^{(n)}), 介绍人, introduced byMohajerin Esfahani et al. (2018)，在我们的设置中是凸的且 Lipschitz 连续的, is convex and Lipschitz continuous in our setting(Mohajerin Esfahani et al., 2018; Bärmann et al., 2018; Kitaoka and Eto, 2023a), 和, andℓsub​(θ)=0\ell_{\mathrm{sub}}(\theta)=0等价于每个观察到的解决方案is equivalent to every observed solutionx(n)x^{(n)}在权重下处于最佳状态being optimal under the weightsθ\theta，即与观测数据完全一致。 因此，一阶在线优化方法（投影次梯度下降、乘法权重更新、在线牛顿步、MetaGrad 等）已应用于次优损失，遗憾和最佳迭代分析提供了渐近保证，即损失随着迭代次数的增加而减少, that is, to exact consistency with the observed data. Consequently, first-order and online optimization methods—projected subgradient descent, multiplicative weights update, online Newton step, MetaGrad, and others—have been applied to the suboptimality loss, and regret and best-iterate analyses provide asymptotic guarantees that the loss decreases as the number of iterationsTT成长grows(Bärmann et al., 2018; Besbes et al., 2021, 2025; Gollapudi et al., 2021; Sakaue et al., 2025).

The obtained lower bounds are polynomial in the dimension and independent of the ranges of the features for M-convex and M♮-凸集，而对于一般的 ILP，它们的维度可以呈指数级变小-convex sets, whereas for general ILPs they can become exponentially small in the dimensiondd。后者与逆优化的NP难度一致. 2. 相关工作Related Work

逆优化研究通常是针对组合和网络优化而发展的Research on inverse optimization has classically developed for combinatorial and network optimization(Ahuja and Orlin, 2001; Heuberger, 2004)，最近，数据驱动框架（根据观测数据估计目标函数或其参数）已从理论和应用角度进行了积极研究, and more recently the data-driven framework—which estimates an objective function or its parameters from observed data—has been actively studied from both theoretical and applied perspectives(Chan et al., 2019, 2023)（引言中回顾了应用程序和损失函数；有关系统调查，请参见(the applications and loss functions were reviewed in the introduction; for systematic surveys seeChan et al. (2019, 2023)，以及与我们相同的环境中相关工作的详细说明，请参见, and for a detailed account of related work in the same setting as ours seeKitaoka (2024)）。在本节中，我们重点关注与本文贡献直接相关的工作：). In this section, we focus on the work directly related to the contributions of this paper: explicit lower bounds onγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})以及迭代次数的明确评估。and explicit evaluations of the number of iterations.

对次优损失的现有保证。Existing guarantees for the suboptimality loss.

对于凸次优损失、遗憾和基于一阶在线优化方法（投影次梯度下降、乘法权重更新、在线牛顿步和 MetaGrad）的最佳迭代分析，已经进行For the convex suboptimality loss, regret and best-iterate analyses based on first-order and online optimization methods—projected subgradient descent, multiplicative weights update, online Newton step, and MetaGrad—have been carried out(Bärmann et al., 2018; Besbes et al., 2021, 2025; Gollapudi et al., 2021; Kitaoka and Eto, 2023a; Sakaue et al., 2025)（有关现有遗憾分析的详细信息，请参见(for details of existing regret analyses seeAppendix˜A，对于离线影响，请参阅, and for the offline implications seeTable˜2）；然而，这些保证仍然是渐进的，其形式为); however, these guarantees remain asymptotic, of the formℓsub​(θt)→0\ell_{\mathrm{sub}}(\theta^{t})\to 0 or min1≤t≤T⁡ℓsub​(θt)→0\min_{1\leq t\leq T}\ell_{\mathrm{sub}}(\theta^{t})\to 0. Kitaoka (2024)将这些渐近保证强化为有限步精确实现，并通过常数设置迭代上限strengthened these asymptotic guarantees into finite-step exact attainment, with an iteration upper bound via the constantγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})，在次优损失是凸分段线性且其极小集合具有相对内点的结构下。, under the structure that the suboptimality loss is convex and piecewise linear and its minimizer set has a relative interior point.

Our framework does not use smoothing and is based on the geometric structure of the suboptimality loss itself.

本文将在有限多次迭代中获得精确一致性的定性保证锐化为根据问题结构量化所需迭代次数的显式评估。我们的迭代上限是通过与问题相关的几何常数来描述的This paper sharpens the qualitative guarantee of attaining exact consistency in finitely many iterations into an explicit evaluation that quantifies the required number of iterations in accordance with the problem structure. Whereas existing first-order/online studies rarely give the number of iterations required for exact consistency as an explicit function of the problem size, this paper, when the forward problem is an integer linear program (ILP), derives an explicit lower bound onγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})从整数规划的结构（总单模性，Graver基础from the structure of integer programming (total unimodularity, the Graver basis(Sturmfels, 1996; Onn, 2010), 和 M-凸度 / M, and M-convexity / M♮-凸性），从而将所需的迭代次数评估为问题大小的显式函数。结果，定量地表明，对于可以利用该结构的广泛情况，或者对于固定维度-convexity), and thereby evaluates the required number of iterations as an explicit function of the problem size. (2018, Theorem 1)显示带有噪声数据的逆优化的 NP 难度。通过这种方式，本文并没有声称一般意义上的多项式时间可解性，而是定量地分离了这两种机制：当可以利用结构时，它保证了多项式迭代边界，而在一般情况下，我们的边界为维度上的指数增长留下了空间show NP-hardness of inverse optimization with noisy data. In this way, rather than claiming polynomial-time solvability in the general sense, this paper quantitatively separates the two regimes: it guarantees polynomial iteration bounds when the structure can be exploited, while in the general case our bounds leave room for exponential growth in the dimensiondd (˜4.4).

与弱尖锐最小值的关系。Relation to weak sharp minima.

实现有限步的关键结构（The structure that is key to the finite-step attainment (Theorem˜4.5）——极小值集有一个相对内点——与弱锐极小值的概念密切相关)—that the set of minimizers has a relative interior point—is closely related to the notion of weak sharp minima(Burke and Ferris, 1993)，并且对弱锐极小值下优化算法的有限终止进行了经典研究, and finite termination of optimization algorithms under weak sharp minima has been studied classically(Polyak, 1987; Ferris, 1991; Burke and Ferris, 1993)。有关这些有限终止理论与非平滑次优损失的基于梯度的方法的有限步实现之间的详细比较，请参阅. For a detailed comparison between these finite-termination theories and the finite-step attainment of gradient-based methods for the nonsmooth suboptimality loss, seeKitaoka (2024)。本文的不同之处不在于是否发生有限终止，而在于其量化：而经典的弱锐极小值有限终止理论没有提供终止前的迭代次数作为问题规模的函数，而本文推导了明确的下界. The difference of the present paper lies not in whether finite termination occurs but in its quantification: whereas the classical finite-termination theory of weak sharp minima does not provide the number of iterations until termination as a function of the problem size, this paper derives explicit lower bounds onγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})来自整数规划的结构（Graver 基、总单模性和 M-凸性/Mfrom the structure of integer programming (Graver bases, total unimodularity, and M-convexity/M♮-凸性；-convexity;˜6和and7），从而将所需的迭代次数作为问题大小的显式函数给出。), thereby giving the required number of iterations as an explicit function of the problem size.

本文的定位。Positioning of this paper.

鉴于此，本文定位于两个工作流的交叉点：次优损失的一阶/在线优化的渐近分析，以及在包括 ILP 在内的离散逆优化中实现与观测数据精确一致性的问题意识。基于梯度的方法对次优损失的有限时间精确可解性，以及一般迭代上限In light of the above, this paper is positioned at the intersection of two streams of work: the asymptotic analysis of first-order/online optimization for the suboptimality loss, and the problem awareness of achieving exact consistency with the observed data in discrete inverse optimization including ILPs. The finite-time exact solvability of gradient-based methods for the suboptimality loss, together with the general iteration upper boundT=O​(1/γ​(ℓsub)2)T=O(1/\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})^{2})通过常数via the constantγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})，成立于, was established byKitaoka (2024);这张纸负责装订; this paper is responsible for boundingγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})从下面看 ILP 的结构。它的新颖之处在于导出常数的显式下界from below in terms of the structure of ILPs. Its novelty is to derive explicit lower bounds on the constantγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})从整数规划的结构（总单模性、Graver 基和 M-凸性/Mfrom the structure of integer programming (total unimodularity, Graver bases, and M-convexity/M♮-凸性），从而给出精确一致性所需的迭代次数作为问题大小的显式函数。-convexity), and thereby to give the number of iterations required for exact consistency as an explicit function of the problem size.

8. 结论Conclusion

在本文中，对于数据驱动的逆优化，其正向问题是整数线性规划（ILP），我们给出了几何常数的显式下界In this paper, for data-driven inverse optimization whose forward problem is an integer linear program (ILP), we gave explicit lower bounds on the geometric constantγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})就整数规划结构而言的次优损失（总单模性、Graver 基和 M-凸性/Mof the suboptimality loss in terms of the structure of integer programming (total unimodularity, Graver bases, and M-convexity/M♮-凸性）。将它们代入基于梯度的优化方法的迭代上限-convexity). Substituting them into the iteration upper bounds for gradient-based optimization methods(Kitaoka, 2024)，我们评估了足以实现与观察数据的精确一致性的迭代次数，作为样本大小、维度、特征范围和约束矩阵结构的显式函数，直至基本常数中的多项式因子。同样，我们对达到最小特征预测损失（PLF）所需的迭代次数给出了明确的限制。获得的下界表明，当可以利用结构时，迭代次数受问题大小的多项式限制，而对于一般的 ILP，它们的维度可以呈指数级小；后者与通过建立的噪声数据逆优化的 NP 难度一致, we evaluated the number of iterations sufficient to achieve exact consistency with the observed data as an explicit function of the sample size, the dimension, the feature ranges, and the structure of the constraint matrix, up to polynomial factors in basic constants. Similarly, we gave an explicit bound on the number of iterations required to attain the minimum of the prediction loss of features (PLF). The obtained lower bounds show that the number of iterations is bounded by a polynomial in the problem size when structure can be exploited, while for general ILPs they can become exponentially small in the dimension; the latter is consistent with the NP-hardness of inverse optimization with noisy data established byAswani et al. (2018)。事实上. In fact˜6.9展示了一个明确的 ILP 实例族，其中exhibits an explicit family of ILP instances on whichγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})呈指数小is exponentially small indd;因此没有下限; hence no lower bound onγ​(ℓsub)\gamma(\ell_{\mathrm{sub}})问题规模中的多项式对于一般的 ILP 可以成立，并且迭代界限的指数依赖关系polynomial in the problem size can hold for general ILPs, and the exponential dependence of the iteration bound ondd是正品。锐化一般 ILP 下限并改进其is genuine. Sharpening the general ILP lower bound and improving itsNdN^{d}为以后的工作留下依赖。dependence are left for future work.
